summary: A dropdown menu of file actions with icons, a separator and a destructive Delete item, reporting the last action.
use: Row or toolbar action menus offering several operations, with the dangerous one set apart.
spec: `<DropdownMenuLabel>File actions</DropdownMenuLabel>` then items Edit, Duplicate, Download
Each item has `{#snippet icon()}` with `<Edit2 />`, `<Copy />`, `<Download />` or `<Trash2 />`
`let last = $state('')` is set per item and shown as `Last action: {last}` with `aria-live="polite"`
